title: Downstream reach of layer 2 q, k, v
question: Does layer 2 q, k, v flatten tilt beyond layer 2, in heads that it can only reach through later layers?
prediction: Layer 2 q, k, v alone will keep most of the full dial tilt change over layers 5 to 51. Removing layer 2 q, k, v from the full dial will lose most of that change. Layer 4 q, k, v alone will keep little.
intervention: Use the frozen adapter and the tilt harness on a 32,768 token segment. Switch on only the named modules at scale 2. Keep the drive, text, and head reading fixed across conditions. Five conditions, 5 books, and 9 passes per book and condition fit in the time estimate.
conditions: Dial scale 0, the unmodified model baseline.
Full dial at scale 2, all 32 modules on.
Layer 2 q, k, v only at scale 2.
Full dial at scale 2 with layer 2 q, k, v switched off.
Layer 4 q, k, v only at scale 2.
control: Layer 4 q, k, v only is the control. It has the same three module types, the same module count, and the same rank as the layer 2 test. Layer 4 is a local layer like layer 2. The measured window starts at layer 5, so both the layer 2 and layer 4 interventions can reach every measured head.
books: Use book set A with 5 books. Measure tokens 90,000 to 122,767 in each book. This range is fresh and lies within every set A book.
primary_metric: For each book, compute tilt over heads in layers 5 to 51 only. A condition share is the tilt drop from dial scale 0 to that condition divided by the tilt drop from dial scale 0 to the full dial. Both drops use the same layers 5 to 51 heads. Report the mean share across the 5 books. This share is a share of the full dial change over layers 5 to 51 only.
pass_rule: Pass if the mean layer 2 q, k, v share is at least 0.60, because 0.60 is a clear majority of the downstream full change. Pass also needs the mean share without layer 2 q, k, v to be at most 0.40, because 0.40 means most of the downstream change is gone. Pass also needs the mean layer 4 q, k, v share to be at most 0.30, because 0.30 is at most half of the required layer 2 share. Pass also needs at least 4 of 5 books with the layer 2 share above the layer 4 share, because 4 of 5 guards against one book driving the mean.
failure_meaning: Failure means the large overall share is mainly a direct layer 2 head effect, or the downstream effect is not specific to layer 2. The lab should not call layer 2 q, k, v a model wide dial site yet.
risks: The downstream full tilt change is small, so shares may be noisy when a book has a near zero denominator.
Layer 2 and layer 4 differ in distance to layer 5, even though both can reach all measured heads.
Five books from one set limit how far the result can be generalized.
A tilt result alone does not prove a loss or behavior change.
why_this_next: Layer 2 q, k, v alone had a share of 0.7971 [F113] over all heads. That share can be dominated by layer 2 own heads. Layer 2 v alone had a share of 0.3816 [F138] over layers 3 to 51, so the downstream reach of q, k, v together is still open. The full dial downstream change over layers 5 to 51 was -0.05161 [F175], so that window is measurable but small. This test separates a direct own head effect from a propagated effect in one run.
